    Class
    Description
    class 
    Clean
    A story graph tool that is a combination of four other tools, which do the following tasks in this order: remove disconnected nodes, remove unused elements, remove duplicate elements, and sort all elements.
    class 
    Explain
    A story graph tool that generates explanations that will improve the author utility and that characters believe will improve their utility.
    class 
    RemoveDisconnected
    A story graph tool that removes all nodes from a story graph that cannot be reached via a path of temporal or epistemic edges from node 0.
    class 
    RemoveDuplicates
    A story graph tool that replaces duplicate elements in a story graph to save memory.
    class 
    RemoveUnexplained
    A story graph tool that removes temporal edges which are not explained for their consenting non-player characters.
    class 
    RemoveUnused
    A story graph tool that removes unused elements from a story graph.
    class 
    Sort
    A story graph tool that sorts the symbols, nodes, and edges of a story graph.
